events.verdict: Sengun (HOU) legally contests Wiggins' (OKC) driving shot attempt and Wiggins brings his off-arm toward Sengun to initiate the marginal contact.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Hartenstein (OKC) lands out of bounds after grabbing the rebound.
Hartenstein (OKC) moves alongside VanVleet's (HOU) path and the leg contact is created by VanVleet veering into him.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) reaches for the ball in Sengun's (HOU) possession and the head contact between the two players is incidental.
Sengun (HOU) is not in possession of the ball for longer than three seconds before a held ball is whistled.
Brooks (HOU) and Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) both get their hands on the ball and a held ball is whistled.
Replay review is triggered after the player altercation during the held ball. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that no additional penalties would be assessed.
Hartenstein (OKC) is in a legal guarding position and absorbs the contact with Sengun (HOU), who loses his balance on his own accord.
Eason (HOU) contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arms.
Joe (OKC) commits a take foul on VanVleet (HOU).
Thompson (HOU) briefly engages with Williams (OKC) during the throw-in and allows him to move freely.
Wallace (OKC) commits a take foul on VanVleet (HOU).
Eason (HOU) legally contests Williams's (OKC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
